patches_added.name: BYD battery (EV)
patches_added.description: Feeds the BYD battery into Maps' EV routing (battery on arrival, chargers). On by default on the tested BYD Dolphin, off with an "untested" notice on other BYD models; a Settings row turns it on or off.

patches_added.name: BYD location flicker fix
patches_added.description: Holds back BYD's brief location off/on flips for up to 3 s, so Maps does not flash its location lockout.

patches_added.name: Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE
patches_added.description: Runs Google Maps for Android Automotive on Android 10 as "Maps Car" with MicroG-RE 7.2.2. Adds a UI density setting, a problem report and a safe mode.

patches_added.name: Send to car
patches_added.description: Lets phone Maps send a trip to Maps Car through MicroG-RE (push routes, the notification service identity and maps.app.goo.gl links).

patches_removed.name: BYD native battery experiment
patches_removed.description: Experimental: sends this BYD's battery and road-load model to Google through Maps' native EV route requests. Starts from the car's own average consumption, learns slowly from BMS energy/distance, and adds in-app vehicle settings. Native hooks inspected on Maps 26.41 and 26.42. Targets BYD DiLink 3; DiLink 5 unverified.

patches_removed.name: Google Maps for MicroG-RE
patches_removed.description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.2.2, skips the uncertified-device screen, avoids a crash when a location-settings dialog cannot open, and prefers synthesized navigation speech with early Google TTS startup and the existing audio fallback.

patches_added.name: Skip consent screens
patches_added.description: Includes tracking controls. Saves OneTrust's real Reject All choice after SDK readiness and skips automatic notification setup. Notifications default off; manual privacy and notification settings remain available.

patches_modified.name: View live anonymously
patches_modified.description: Keeps you off the viewer list of the lives you watch, so the host isn't told you're there. Your own lives still count their viewers. An optional eye button at the top of a live puts you on that one's list. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Share, Save or speaker button, or the line naming the reel's sound. It can also open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them, and hide the one-tap Subscribe button some authors get instead of Follow, or Search and the button beside it at the top of a video you open. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_added.name: Audio and video switch
patches_added.description: Adds a song and video switch to the top of the player, as in YouTube Music: one tap plays a song's music video, or the song again, in the same place in the queue. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_added.name: Flac Downloader Audio
patches_added.description: Optional native adapter for aztecempire's Spotube FLAC Audio source. Search, stream and download through flacdownloader.com, with explicit FLAC/MP3 choices. Starts disabled; enable in Sources or Patches & tweaks. Requested quality is not file verification. No Spotube runtime or account is installed.

patches_added.name: Mixed-source playlists
patches_added.description: Adds downloaded files, local audio and streamed tracks to device playlists without a YouTube account. Preserves file and addon source metadata across restarts. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks.

patches_added.name: Streamseek previews
patches_added.description: Preview an explicitly selected Soulseek MP3 or FLAC through Media3 while it transfers. Keep download reuses buffered bytes. Compare an excerpt with a known local reference and export transparent evidence. Optional; enable in Patches & tweaks. No automatic Soulseek playback or Mornye integration.

patches_modified.name: Unofficial Soulseek audio
patches_modified.description: Adds player-integrated Downloads on BitChord 1.9, addon/Soulseek source choices, batch review, selected-file public Soulseek sharing, and verified Telegram archiving/restore. Telegram copies require the optional Telegram patch and your private main channel. Debrid services use your API keys. Live Soulseek playback stays disabled. Settings are in Patches & tweaks. Android 8 or newer.
patches_modified.previous_description: Download selected Soulseek or debrid audio to a phone folder, a configured Telegram main channel, or both. Optional debrid services use your own API keys. Choose accepted formats and their order in setup. Live playback and automatic source matching are disabled. Settings are in Settings, Patches & tweaks. Android 8 or newer.

patches_added.name: Android Auto messages
patches_added.description: Lets Android Auto read your Messenger messages out loud and send the replies you speak, through its own messaging screen. Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store until you turn on Unknown sources in its developer settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
